summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Zenkai cyberpunk eCommerce. All 14 listed features verified end-to-end via Playwright against the public preview URL. JWT Bearer-token auth (localStorage 'zenkai_token') working. Login, register, logout, cart, wishlist, checkout (Stripe session creation), admin dashboard/products/orders/editor, ProtectedRoute guards, newsletter, search, sort, category filters, and toasts all verified. No critical issues found.

issues: Hero <h1> renders without space between the two coloured spans, producing inner text 'Power YourAnime World' (renders correctly visually because the spans are on separate lines, but copy-paste / a11y screen reader will read it concatenated). Consider adding a non-breaking space or aria-label.

critical_code_review_comments: Admin tab list only renders 3 buttons (dashboard/products/orders); the 'editor' view is reachable only via the 'New Product' button or row edit icon. Request listed Editor as a tab — functionality works but UX is implicit. Acceptable as-is but worth documenting.

ProductCard's add-to-cart button (data-testid='add-to-cart-{id}') is rendered with opacity-0 and only appears on group-hover. Mobile/touch devices have no hover state; clicks still work, but users may not discover it. Consider opacity-100 on small screens.
Hero <h1> 'POWER YOUR ANIME WORLD' is split into two coloured spans without an intervening whitespace, so the accessible text concatenates to 'Power YourAnime World'. Add a space or use aria-label.

wishlist toggle: GET /wishlist returned empty list after POST /wishlist/{pid} returned 200 in one of my runs. The endpoint is a toggle, so consecutive test runs flip the state. Not a bug — just an observation for future regression tests (idempotency vs toggle semantics).

Carried over from iteration_2: server.py >700 lines, no auth rate-limit, no CSRF on cookie-auth — although app has now moved to Bearer-token in localStorage, so CSRF is less of a concern, but storing JWT in localStorage exposes to XSS. Consider httpOnly cookies once k8s CORS issue is resolved.
test_credentials: Admin admin@zenkai.com / ZenkaiAdmin@2026 verified working. New users registered via /register UI work and immediately get token + user menu.
seed_data_creation: Created throw-away test users via /register (testuser{timestamp}@zenkai.com / TestPass@2026). Newsletter subscriptions seeded with news{timestamp}@test.com. No products created/modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend testids in use: navbar [logo-link, nav-home, nav-shop, nav-categories, search-input, cart-btn, cart-count, login-link, user-menu-btn, logout-btn, nav-admin, wishlist-link]; home [hero-title, hero-shop-btn, cat-card-{slug}x5, trending-section, bestsellers-section, newarrivals-section, newsletter-input, newsletter-submit]; shop [shop-page, filter-{slug}, sort-select (values: default/price_asc/price_desc/name), product-card-{id}]; product-card [wishlist-toggle-{id}, add-to-cart-{id}]; product detail [product-image, product-name, product-price, qty-plus/minus, add-cart-btn, wishlist-btn]; cart drawer [cart-drawer, cart-item-{id}, qty-plus/minus-{id}, cart-remove-{id}, checkout-btn]; login [login-email, login-password, login-submit, register-link]; register [register-name/email/password/submit]; profile [profile-page, profile-email, profile-name, tab-orders, tab-wishlist, orders-panel, wishlist-panel]; admin [admin-page, admin-tab-{dashboard|products|orders} (only 3 tabs), admin-dashboard, admin-products, admin-orders, new-product-btn, edit-{id}, delete-{id}, product-editor, form-name/desc/category/anime/price/stock, upload-image, save-product]. Auth: Bearer token in localStorage as 'zenkai_token' — verified set on login/register and cleared on logout.
verified_flows: Home renders hero, 5 bento category cards, trending/bestsellers/new-arrivals product sections, marquee anime tags, newsletter form
Navbar shows logo/Home/Shop/Categories dropdown (10 items on hover)/search/cart/login when logged out and user-menu+nav-admin when admin

Shop /shop lists 19 products; sort-select native <select> works (values default/price_asc/price_desc/name); category filter /shop?category=led_frames shows 4 products; search /shop?search=naruto shows 1 product
Product detail loads with image, name, price, description, qty +/- 1, Add to Cart, Wishlist; toast appears on add
Register flow creates account → token persisted in localStorage 'zenkai_token' → redirected home → user menu visible
Login admin@zenkai.com / ZenkaiAdmin@2026 → 243-char JWT in localStorage → user-menu-btn + nav-admin visible
Logout clears localStorage token and shows login-link again
Cart: add from product detail → cart-count badge updates → cart drawer opens → cart-item rendered with qty controls and remove
Checkout: clicking checkout-btn calls POST /api/checkout/session which returns 200 and frontend redirects (request initiated to checkout.stripe.com)
Wishlist: POST /api/wishlist/{pid} returns 200 from heart icon; /wishlist page renders product grid; Profile→Wishlist tab panel renders
Profile /profile shows user email and tabs (tab-orders, tab-wishlist) both clickable

Admin /admin renders dashboard with 4 stat cards (Total Revenue, Orders, Products=19, Customers=6) + Revenue by Category + Recent Orders. Products and Orders tabs accessible. Editor opens via 'New Product' button → product-editor form with upload-image and save-product
ProtectedRoute: unauth /profile and /admin both redirect to /login
Sonner toasts visible for add-to-cart and other actions
rca_of_the_issue: n/a — no critical issues found this iteration. Test-script-side issues encountered: (1) Initially used wrong testid names (logo, cart-button, category-card-, marquee) — corrected to logo-link/cart-btn/cat-card-; (2) Used sort value 'price-asc' (dash) but app uses 'price_asc' (underscore); (3) Briefly observed empty wishlist after toggle, root cause was a previous test run had already toggled the same product OFF — toggle semantics confirmed correct.
